rationale: Both documents explicitly credit White-Bear Steering (Raman et al.) as the prior-art route the method builds on/diverges from, using the same cosine-similarity figure (≈0.75) to show the new contrast direction differs from it. The message goes further than the write-up by adding a concrete quantitative head-to-head comparison (a WBS-style anchor scoring 0.3725 vs. the method's 0.4412) and by naming the specific bench family ('directed_modulation'), details the write-up omits or leaves vague.
